task: Havenline conveyor source and systems preflight
score_reason: No new candidate has been reviewed; no completion score is awarded for a checklist.
scope: Independent review of new static conveyor concept/routing design only; no runtime/model/GitHub modifications.
verified_constraints: Advanced storage has fixed front paired sliding door/rail and crate apron, right orange-framed vented fuel hatch, left high frosted window, rear high round vent; no approved conveyor product ports.

Storage organization is U-shaped perimeter shelving with clear central aisle: timber left-front, minerals left-rear, hides rear-left, food rear-center, cargo/cash rear-right, fuel partition right-front. A proposed through-wall connection must explain how stock reaches the intended compartment.

Customer table has four legs and lower shelf; black register fixed to customer-left end with controls facing staff rear; table elsewhere remains stock/handoff surface. Blue processing station is a distinct asset.
Cooker/processor has raw wooden crate on physical left and metal output tray on right, central front access and side pressure hardware; new feeds need proposed attachable transitions at these sides.
Source straight conveyor is an inclined orange-rail black-roller unit with blue housing at low end; universal flat belt height cannot be assumed.
Intake has front roller lip and twin rear cylindrical basket forms; no interpretation that these cylinders are downstream conveyor sockets is established by static art.
Lumber/saw assets visibly support timber handling; plank association is a new production proposal with unknown recipe. Do not chain every depicted saw/mill as sequential conversions by default.
Furnace/hearth historical operation creates warmth/upgrades rather than metal or food output.
Whole fish to cooked whole-fish form and wheat to bread-like stack are locked observed references; quantities, timing, fuel, intermediate recipes and machine tier bindings are not established.
Raw logs or raw meat can be valid customer sale goods when the service catalogue explicitly allows them. A conveyor must preserve item identity: raw-material sale is not finished-goods conversion.

historical_attachment_warning.meaning: Historical GLB metadata has mismatched elevations and is not a binding for newer concept art. Require explicit adapter/adjustable-transfer proposals; do not silently adopt old numeric scale as approved.

design_options: A staff-transfer receiving/dispatch buffer beside the front apron preserves shell without new holes; identify worker handoff so automation is not implied through a wall.
A fully automatic storage extension needs explicit new typed sleeves and an internal transfer/buffer cutaway, separated from fuel hatch/window/vent and central entrance.
Prefer independent clean-food and utility/material lanes over a single mixed-resource loop. Label any mechanical standardization or modular upgrade as proposed.

mandatory_checks.acceptance: Every station/recipe/material route has a source or explicit proposal status; old visual kit is not claimed as live runtime evidence.
Show at least one meaningful machine-to-machine route, machine-to-storage route and storage/product-to-customer restock route, with named item form at each handoff.
Each lane has unambiguous arrows, exclusive transfer ownership and separate input/output; no immediate store-in/store-out loop or duplicated goods.

Food stays off fuel/mineral lanes; whole fish does not become fillet without a proposed recipe; ore never becomes ingot by transport; camp heater is not a production smelter. Raw log/meat sale is valid only where the counter catalogue permits that item; distinguish raw sale from conversion to a finished product.
Preserve centered front doors/apron, right fuel-service hatch, left window and rear high vent. Any new product opening/dock is explicit proposed geometry with interior receiving/dispatch explanation.

Preserve canonical timber table/register orientation, stock area, four legs/lower shelf, customer approach and staff position; end restock feed in staff-accessible buffer at free stock end; cash never rides product line.
Cooker central access/control remains clear; side adapters bridge actual input crate/output tray; historical socket-height mismatches are not hidden.
Actual render shows compatible belt width/height, transition/bridge plate, continuous supported carry surface, guard clearance and believable ground contact without penetration/floating goods.
Typed outlets/filter or pre-sorted lane rule is visible; wrong/unknown items halt at input or enter bounded reject buffer; no accidental contamination or silent destruction.
Counter full, storage full and downstream blocked states show stop-before-release/backpressure; upstream pauses before item overlap; no infinite belt queue or uncontrolled overflow.
Counter dispatch follows accepted item/demand/reserve rule; surplus storage and later restock cannot endlessly recirculate or bypass stock limits.

Plan keeps centered heater and two distinct usable bidirectional openings, clear player/operator walk lanes, storage front access and counter customer queues. Belt crossings are avoided or have explicit clearance solution.

New modules share rounded orange rails, dark roller/belt, silver joints and restrained blue fittings with source style; no change to source originals; all needed turns/branch/adapter parts in plan actually exist. Scope includes straight, corner, controlled merge, filter/priority diverter, stop/buffer and height/port adapters.

Inspect actual selected images including plan/topology, useful oblique/cardinal interfaces, closeups, normal loaded flow and blocked/full states. No approval from text or a single attractive hero view.

Exact prompts/ordered inputs, original+repair image hashes, source/video inspection levels, failed and passed reviews and final verified GitHub asset paths retained; publication verification belongs root.
Static reference concept is not native mesh, rig, collision, operational simulation, resolved recipes/rates/costs, precise world scale or physical-device performance approval.

video_review_boundary: Other reference agents own video playback audit and supplemental research. This preflight has read the exact lock, not claimed video playback.
next_action: Root supplies exact requirements/routing plan before generation; critic checks graph and then reviews generated outputs with actual image evidence; fix and retest any failed mandatory check.
proposed_deliverable_scope: Multi-angle modular straight/corner/merge/filter/stop-buffer and height-adapter kit
Explicit new storage receive/dispatch extension with visible transfer mechanism
Food production and customer-counter integration views
Exact overall route and clearance diagram

recommended_storage_upgrade.placement: One typed utility cassette on left wall, one clean finished-food cassette on rear wall; new low product sleeves remain separate from existing high window and rear round vent.
recommended_storage_upgrade.ports: Each cassette has distinct one-way receive and dispatch ports with an interlocked bounded tray, short internal transfer lift and direct connection to its assigned perimeter bay.
recommended_storage_upgrade.initial_automation: Utility timber/material bays and prepared-food compartment only. Raw food, fuel, hides/fur, cargo and cash remain independently staffed/manual unless further typed routes and mechanisms are explicitly provided.
recommended_storage_upgrade.preserved: Existing front doors and full apron, center aisle, right fuel hatch, high left window, rear high vent and six-zone organization remain recognizable and usable.
recommended_storage_upgrade.footprint: External cassettes add a small declared service footprint; this is a new logistics upgrade, not an assertion that previous house footprint already included them.
recommended_storage_upgrade.boundary: Automatic through-wall transfer has no inherited source approval; proposed mechanism and receiving/dispatch states must be shown. A generic enclosed box does not prove sorting or storage automation.
